metadata.title: Mohammad Kikhia | My Portfolio
metadata.description: Mohammad Kikhia is a professional frontend web developer from Syria, specializing in ReactJS and NextJS. With a strong focus on user experience and interactive design, I create efficient and innovative web solutions. Explore my portfolio to see my work and learn more about my expertise in modern web technologies.
metadata.author: Mohammad Kikhia

hero.title: Hi there, I'm Mohammad {span}Kikhia{span}
hero.subtitle: I am into:
subtext: Implementing UI/UX designs into interactive websites

about.title: I'm Mohammad
about.subtitle: React & Next.js developer
about.subtext: As a dedicated ReactJS-NextJS developer with three years of experience, I bring a passion for coding and a year of hands-on freelance experience to the table. My commitment to writing clean, well-documented, and accessible code using modern frameworks ensures that every project I work on is of the highest quality. I take pride in creating digital solutions that are not only functional but also beautifully crafted with love.

skills.title: Skills & {span}Stack{span}
skills.subtitle: Tools I build with
skills.intro: I care a lot about writing frontends that are reliable, predictable and easy to evolve, not just nice to look at.
highlights: Comfortable moving across the stack: from designing UI flows and components to wiring data and handling edge cases
Used to working in real-world teams with code review, version control, linting and automated checks
Focused on performance, accessibility and long‑term maintainability rather than quick hacks

items.title: Frontend Developer
items.description: OverZaki is a leading company in AI-powered solutions. I work full-time on a large web product that combines a website builder with business management tooling—helping teams run day-to-day operations in one place.
highlights: Rich product surface: POS flows, WhatsApp Business integrations, staff management, and many adjacent features across the platform
Frontend ownership across complex screens: performance-minded UI, predictable state, and maintainable components in a fast-moving roadmap
Close collaboration with product and backend teams to ship end-to-end experiences customers rely on daily

items.title: Freelance Frontend Developer
items.description: Delivered frontend work for clients on a project basis—turning designs into responsive interfaces, integrating APIs, and polishing UX details before handoff.
highlights: Built and iterated on marketing sites and web apps using modern React ecosystems
Practiced clear communication, scope management, and shipping in short feedback loops
